technique_name: Compose a short critique of the following artwork.
description: This is a piece by the artist Yayoi Kusama titled "Obliteration Room". It is a work of installation art and features a space painted entirely white with colorful polka dots and multicolored stickers applied to its surfaces. The work is a collaboration with children from the Kids Club of Melbourne who add to the artwork with their colorful stickers that cover the white walls.
